books.title: The Last Lantern
books.author: M. K. Vale
books.description: A detective returns to a coastal town where every answer is hidden in lighthouse logs and tide charts.
books.about: The Last Lantern blends investigative suspense with atmospheric coastal fiction. As clues emerge from journals and forgotten boat ledgers, the story explores grief, legacy, and what people protect when the town is watching.

audiobookTracks.title: Track 1 - A Light on the Water

books.title: Echoes at Dawn
books.author: Nira Sol
books.description: A cursed musician can rewrite fate by performing forbidden songs at sunrise.
books.about: A lyrical fantasy where sound becomes magic and every performance has a cost. Echoes at Dawn follows a reluctant hero through abandoned theaters, mountain shrines, and villages that trade memories for songs.

reviews.name: Asha
reviews.text: Beautifully written worldbuilding and unique magic rules.
